def generate_multipart(
        self,
        ranges: typing.Sequence[tuple[int, int]],
        boundary: str,
        max_size: int,
        content_type: str,
    ) -> tuple[int, typing.Callable[[int, int], bytes]]:
        r"""
        Multipart response headers generator.

        ```
        --{boundary}\n
        Content-Type: {content_type}\n
        Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n
        \n
        ..........content...........\n
        --{boundary}\n
        Content-Type: {content_type}\n
        Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n
        \n
        ..........content...........\n
        --{boundary}--\n
        ```
        """
        boundary_bytes = boundary.encode("latin-1")
        content_type_bytes = content_type.encode("latin-1")
        
        # Calculate content length
        content_length = 0
        for start, end in ranges:
            # Header part: boundary + headers + newline
            header_size = (
                2 + len(boundary_bytes) + 2 +  # --boundary\r\n
                13 + len(content_type_bytes) + 2 +  # Content-Type: ...\r\n
                16 + len(str(start)) + len(str(end - 1)) + len(str(max_size)) + 2 +  # Content-Range: bytes start-end/max_size\r\n
                2  # \r\n after headers
            )
            content_length += header_size + (end - start) + 1  # +1 for trailing newline
        
        # Add final boundary
        content_length += 4 + len(boundary_bytes) + 2  # --boundary--\r\n
        
        def header_generator(start: int, end: int) -> bytes:
            return (
                b"--" + boundary_bytes + b"\r\n"
                b"Content-Type: " + content_type_bytes + b"\r\n"
                b"Content-Range: bytes " + str(start).encode() + b"-" + str(end - 1).encode() + b"/" + str(max_size).encode() + b"\r\n"
                b"\r\n"
            )
        
        return (content_length, header_generator)
